title: Week 16 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “cost of attendance”?
options: An institution’s estimate of tuition, fees, housing, food, books, transportation, and other education costs.
A numerical estimate of credit risk based on a scoring model and report data.
Manipulation of people into revealing information or taking unsafe action.
Nonwage compensation such as insurance, retirement contribution, leave, or tuition support.
questions.explanation: Cost of attendance means an institution’s estimate of tuition, fees, housing, food, books, transportation, and other education costs.
